title: The White Poplar

services.name: Included With Your Rental
services.desc: We use these for many misc. purposes from holding popcorn bags to serving McDonalds late night snacks! We will move our arbor to where ever you are planning to have your ceremony, and the choice to decorate it is yours! We put our LOVE out for every wedding. We have favorite locations for our LOVE, depending on the weather. The distance from the mantle to the firebox is 28.5”, from the mantle to where the chimney starts is 12”, and the chimney is 35”
